home.title: Your portal data.
home.description: Get to know your sports and country data, and explore it through a conversation with the AI Advisor. One place to ask questions and find your way around the portal.
home.accessNote: Everyone is welcome here. Sign in to use the AI Advisor.
home.questionSports: Which sports are available in the portal?
home.questionCountries: What countries are listed in the system?
home.previewNote: Example questions, not live results. The advisor uses portal data to help answer your questions.
home.featuresDescription: A straightforward starting point for exploring the information in Bet Portal.
home.dataDescription: Learn about the sports and countries recorded in the system. Ask the advisor for context instead of searching through data on your own.
home.advisorDescription: The AI Advisor offers a conversational way to explore portal information. Ask a question, follow up, and keep the discussion in one place.
home.languageDescription: Choose English, Czech, or German from the profile menu. The portal and login form follow your selected language.
home.startTitle: Curiosity is a good starting point.
home.startDescription: You can read about the portal without an account. When you are ready to ask questions, sign in with your existing account.
home.stepOneDescription: Open the profile menu at the top of the page and select the language you prefer.
home.stepTwoDescription: Use your existing account to access the AI Advisor.
home.stepThreeDescription: Ask about portal data and use follow-up questions to explore further.
home.disclaimer: AI responses can contain mistakes. Verify important information. This portal does not guarantee betting outcomes; treat its content as information, not betting advice.
